# FDG6004

> CONSIDER using callbacks to allow users to provide custom code to be executed by the framework.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 6.1.3 Events and Callbacks.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library suggestion, application none, test none
- Status: verified

Library only: callbacks let the users of a framework run their own code in it. Not an analyzer candidate: a design option.
